question: How do the new tissue RNA and tissue-local clone results distinguish biological alternatives while retaining animal variation and limits?
decision: Present four biological extension plates with brief in-image rationale/result captions; preserve original figure editions.
strongest_rival: Pooled cells, missing design strata, changing denominators or unverified source labels can look convincing when rendered without unit and selection context.
discriminator: Display individual mice, source versus released counts, cell-weighted and mouse-weighted summaries, distinct RNA endpoints, fixed markers and documented repertoire denominators.
exposure_record: Both biological extension runs and their full displayed-gene and focal-tissue outcomes have been inspected. Rendering is exposed documentation, not validation or a new biological model.
biological_unit: Deposited mouse within each assay and tissue; slash-containing lung IDs are explicitly pooled libraries, excluded from mouse-weighted expression contrasts and composition accounting.
nesting_and_overlap: Repeated tissue and assay samples and the general versus Figure 4 brain objects reuse mice/cells. IDs use different source formats. No cross-organ independence, canonical cross-assay identity resolution or external replication is asserted.
population_and_selection: Frozen composition and repertoire biological_v1 outputs. Display genes Cdkn2a, Cdkn1a, Lmnb1 and Il1b; focal thymus/spleen/marrow fixed before those runs. All marker and tissue outputs remain available.
contrast: Original frozen contrasts and endpoints, with percentage-point conversion for detection and clone fractions.
endpoint: Four PNG/SVG/PDF plates, combined four-page PDF and figure manifest with compact captions and layout checks.
methods: White background, 300-dpi PNG, vector text/axes in SVG/PDF. Four-term RNA accounting; within-type detection; connected per-mouse observed/fixed-reference values; local clone fractions and exact common-depth expectations; tissue composition and shared clones. All values come from frozen outputs, with arithmetic group means only. Show all mice in displayed panels; figure 10 A–C uses balanced mice and D uses all supported tissue mice. Captions in 9-point short footnotes with renderer-wrapped text and bounds checks.
missingness_and_exclusions: Inherited fixed common-type universe and balanced tissue selection. No missing value is replaced by a zero; no new cell/model fit.
multiplicity: No p-values, significance stars, rankings by effect or confirmatory claims. The fixed descriptive marker family and all contrasts are retained, including null/unfavorable values.
precision_basis: Show every observed mouse and descriptive means; no biological-effect margin, independent unit variance justification or confirmatory power is available.
interpretation_limit: No significance, causal component, senescence, secretion, migration, immune function, within-subtype matching or global RQ promotion is inferred from figures.
stop_rule: Stop if frozen input hashes fail or plotting/layout assertions fail. Inspect all PNGs; future corrections use a new version.
amendment_reason: New biological extension outputs require additional figures; original figure plates remain archived unchanged.
